title_zh: 确认婚礼邀请和轻松着装要求

scenario.goal_zh: 邀请朋友及其伴侣参加婚礼并澄清着装要求

context_zh: 即将结婚的人向朋友确认邀请范围和着装要求。
author: author-phase07-a

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: I'd love you to come to the wedding, and please bring your partner too.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Thank you. We'd both like to come. Is there a dress code?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: It's a casual wedding in the garden. You don't need a suit or a tie.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Would a shirt and clean trainers be all right?

sentences.speaker: Sofia
sentences.text: Absolutely. Wear something you can sit and walk in comfortably.

sentences.speaker: Eli
sentences.text: Lovely. I'll reply for both of us tonight.

targets.sense_zh: 不拘正式礼仪、轻松随意的
